record.issue_text: `app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:26-31`: `rescue URI::InvalidURIError` placement means `X-Frame-Options` is never set when the referer URI is invalid

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, `response.headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'ALLOWALL'` is only set after the referer host validation passes. If `URI(request.referer || '')` raises `URI::InvalidURIError`, the rescue re-raises `Discourse::InvalidAccess`, so the request is rejected; not setting `X-Frame-Options` on a rejected/errored request is expected and does not constitute a defect in the diff.
